$comment: Client-neutral discovery manifest for the ProAppStore Agent Skills plugin (#169). Claude Code reads .claude-plugin/plugin.json and .claude-plugin/marketplace.json; other Agent Skills clients install the skill directories listed here. Validated by scripts/build-skills-manifest.mjs --check (every listed skill must exist and every skill directory must be listed).
name: proappstore
description: Portable ProAppStore Agent Skills (agentskills.io format) packaged with the ProAppStore MCP server.

permissions.credentials: none — the plugin carries no tokens; the MCP server authenticates the user's own session (GitHub or Google)
permissions.read_only_tools: every skill's allowed-tools are read-only MCP tools; see skills/index.json
permissions.mutating_tools: provision_pas_app / scaffold_app (create-proappstore-app: dry-run then explicit confirm) and qa_run (publish-deploy: queues a browser smoke run)
permissions.repository: advisory skills edit only the user's own app repository, one reviewed stage at a time; deploys happen by the user's git push

clients.install: copy each skills/<name>/ directory into the Codex skills directory; add the MCP server with the stdio or remote command above
clients.update: replace the directories with the current main (compare digests in skills/index.json)
clients.uninstall: delete the directories and the MCP server entry

clients.install: copy each skills/<name>/ directory into the Copilot skills location per its documentation; add the MCP server
clients.update: replace the directories with the current main
clients.uninstall: delete the directories and the MCP server entry
